title: Prosodic Speech Features V2.5
description: The format of the Data of a Speech Descriptors Object (MMC-SDO-V2.5): the JSON text of its inline Data, or of what its DataURI gives, with no Qualifier that carries the prosodic features of a speech segment: what Speech Feature Analysis 1 (CAE-SFA) gives Prosodic Emotion Insertion (CAE-PEI). It replaces SpeechDescriptors1 and ProsodicSpeechDescriptors of CAE V2.1, which were the same schema.
